message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which strips every character outside `a-z0-9`, accented letters included. I left `vendor/` alone, as you asked. The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`, where `postSlug` now removes the accent marks before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs also go through the vendored `slugify` and will still drop accented letters. If you want them fixed too, it needs the same change in `src/shop/product-url.js`, or an upgrade from the platform team.
